title: 進路セミナーⅠ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar I
educationalGoal: In addition to measuring the future career and forming a professional view as an engineer, students will set goals and envision advancement/employment plans suitable for themselves, and recognize the voluntary and ambitious actions needed to prepare to achieve those goals.
advice:
The course addresses the following two main issues:
1.	Investigating occupational awareness through lectures by career teachers and senior students, and through internships, open desks, etc., in students' search for the ideal career path.
2.	Planning and beginning to address issues that require a relatively long period of preparation and proactive behavior, such as acquiring qualifications, developing general common sense, and successfully completing the comprehensive aptitude test (SPI).

* Some lectures may be delivered via on-demand video.
* The contents and methods presented here are subject to change depending on the infectious disease and the availability of the speaker.
requiredKnowledge: Career seminars are lectures mainly for job hunting, and are held to prepare students for the employment front. In order to prepare for job hunting and job examinations, all students need to take this course regardless of their advancement or employment. In addition, this learning will be reference material for employment placement in the following year.

              In addition to measuring the future career and forming a professional view as an engineer, students will set goals and envision advancement/employment plans suitable for themselves, and recognize the voluntary and ambitious actions needed to prepare to achieve those goals.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The course addresses the following two main issues:
1.	Investigating occupational awareness through lectures by career teachers and senior students, and through internships, open desks, etc., in students' search for the ideal career path.
2.	Planning and beginning to address issues that require a relatively long period of preparation and proactive behavior, such as acquiring qualifications, developing general common sense, and successfully completing the comprehensive aptitude test (SPI).

* Some lectures may be delivered via on-demand video.
* The contents and methods presented here are subject to change depending on the infectious disease and the availability of the speaker.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              Textbooks are not used.

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              Career seminars are lectures mainly for job hunting, and are held to prepare students for the employment front. In order to prepare for job hunting and job examinations, all students need to take this course regardless of their advancement or employment. In addition, this learning will be reference material for employment placement in the following year.
